sentences.text: He began to burn a candle.
There is ice on the mountain.
We threw away the rotten fruit.
A dull knife does not cut.
After rain the ground is wet.
The book is on the table.
The bird sits on the tree.
The key is on the door.
A book is inside the box.
I bought a book and a pencil.
If it rains we will stay home.
If there is time we will meet.
I stayed because it was raining.
I laughed because I heard a joke.
I went because he called me.
Write the name on the paper.
